description: Search TV series on tvsubtitles.net, read a season's subtitle coverage and one record. No API key.
name: io.github.smeet666/mcp-tvsubtitles

environmentVariables.description: Placed in front of this server's own User-Agent, which stays attached.
environmentVariables.name: TVS_USER_AGENT

environmentVariables.description: Minimum milliseconds between requests. Default 2000, floor 1500.
environmentVariables.name: TVS_MIN_INTERVAL_MS

environmentVariables.description: silent, error, info or debug. Default error.
environmentVariables.name: TVS_LOG_LEVEL
